scope: Six Compose resource fonts only; excludes jlatexmath dependency fonts
method: Built-in Node Buffer SFNT name, cmap, fvar, OS/2, post, maxp parser; no font installed or application executed
limitations: cmap formats 0/4/6/10/12/13 parsed; unsupported records explicitly listed
cmap coverage does not establish shaping, variation-selector support, locale behavior or font fallback
Names are declarations; native UI assignments, CSS selection, and glyph rasterization are unverified
No font license interpretation; retained name records are original metadata
